findings.title: Approved daily report runtime proof defects
findings.violation: Production daily path still sends before admission; approved candidate fails real PostgreSQL runtime proof: campaignIdempotencyKey opaque-code rejection and TransactionWriteConflict (2/8 effects in first case). No runtime deployment accepted.
findings.existingCanonicalFoundation: APPROVED OwnerReportRun schema and INBOX → TELEGRAM → APNS contract; existing A12 / Communication Delivery; sufficient for defect repair.

findings.title: Weekly expense reminder and expense reply authority
findings.violation: Raw ANTON_CHAT_ID + process-local awaiting flag; direct Telegram; unrelated reply can become expense; date-wide replacement deletes before validated immutable admission. Parallel SQLite financial owner.
findings.existingCanonicalFoundation: P407 canonical create/delete/period-declare + Action Engine + A13 transport exist; durable reminder/reply identity and confirmation binding missing. Existing Stage1 proposal is not approval.

findings.title: Public PHP booking bypass
productionPaths: salon and VPS PWA BookingFlow / repeat-booking fallback
findings.violation: Phone/fullname/company_id selects provider booking; direct yc_post → file_get_contents POST records/book_record without canonical Client, Appointment owner or Action Engine. Network ambiguity becomes request_failed; UI offers retry, no durable execution identity. POST is not automatically retried inside PHP, but a later user retry is unbound.
findings.existingCanonicalFoundation: B31 canonical Client create + B32 principal + immutable booking binding + existing provider executor. Reuse or fail closed under approved authority; guest phone is not authority.

findings.title: Native Telegram Client authority and projection fallbacks
findings.violation: Raw sender/local Client and supplied or legacy phone select profile/history/booking target; SQLite clients updated as a parallel profile; booking bridge runs as integration system and carries phone-derived legacy-client reference instead of verified canonical Client ownership. Canonical Action Engine transport alone does not prove end-user authority. Contact with missing contact.user_id is accepted.
findings.existingCanonicalFoundation: Verified ClientChannelLink/Client principal, B31 create, canonical cancel/reschedule/read, A18 profile commands already exist. Native Telegram initiator must meet these contracts; no automatic linking by phone.

findings.title: Telegram direct staff binding remains executable
findings.violation: Existing masters_telegram row can be rebound with direct UPDATE, skipping disabled reset_master_bind_code branch. Raw legacy admin authorizes grant; startup also repopulates raw admin authority. No canonical CrmStaffAccess command/execution.
findings.existingCanonicalFoundation: A16 configure_crm_staff_access, canonical Membership/User/AuthIdentity and approved retirement of legacy bind codes; existing owner sufficient.

findings.title: Legacy owner/session authority remains a parallel gate
productionPaths: legacy Yandex/VK session issuer and /start web-session branch
findings.violation: Signed channel identity or legacy web_session is promoted through FOUNDER_IDS/admins to business owner without exact active canonical User/Membership/tenant; staff-specific retirement does not remove owner branch. Phone/social-map fallback can issue a legacy staff session; revocation of canonical authority need not revoke this gate.
findings.existingCanonicalFoundation: Canonical JWT/auth session, exact Membership and CrmStaffAccess resolvers; B13/B20/B32 approved boundaries; AC3 auth facts may remain only within their exact canonical scope.

findings.title: Parallel operational work journal and read-time mutation
productionPaths: chat __runjob and Python AI owner tools
findings.violation: Direct mutable owner_action_journal outside OperationalWorkItem/Action Engine; scheduler and model create/update work; nominal read surfaces evaluate and write impact facts. Cooldown/settings timestamp and process tasks do not provide durable command identity or partial resume.
findings.existingCanonicalFoundation: A23 OperationalWorkItem / Wave1 governed commands; A29/A31 fact/projection separation. Existing supported actions can converge; do not invent extra autonomous business permissions.

findings.title: Non-daily reports have no immutable durable recipient plan
findings.violation: Morning/master reports use Inbox existence as completion and recalculate recipients/content/devices; Python briefs/PDF send directly to raw identities, settings marker written before effects. A partial run/restart lacks fixed report plan and same executions.
findings.existingCanonicalFoundation: A12/CD transport exists; approved OwnerReportRun schema constrains daily_report/version1. Other report kinds/recipient authority/content and PDF delivery are not implicitly approved by B36.

findings.title: Scheduled operational alerts bypass canonical owner/delivery
findings.violation: Raw founder/admin/master lists, direct Telegram before any admission; settings or in-memory sent set either suppress after failure or permit repeated effects; no durable parent/recipient plan. Legacy Web Push helpers return zero, which does not repair the Telegram path.
findings.existingCanonicalFoundation: A13 and Communication Delivery recipient/attempt lifecycle exist. Exact alert occurrence owner, audience/recipient authority and durable partial-plan contract are not established for every listed producer.

findings.title: Native Telegram dynamic appointment reminder duplicates canonical owner
findings.violation: Process-local scheduled reminder owns direct Telegram by user_id/record_id; no canonical Appointment/Client occurrence, durable admitted plan or UNKNOWN reconciliation. Preference errors fall through to send.
findings.existingCanonicalFoundation: B25 canonical reminder orchestration and existing A11/CD are available; reuse exact admitted occurrence and verified Client.

findings.title: Scheduled/manual retention marketing still bypasses B35 bulk owner
productionPaths: cycle_reminder.run_cycle_reminder_job via manual commands,panel job,chat confirmation
findings.violation: Canonical consent read is followed by local raw Telegram audience and direct send. No immutable audience/route manifest, canonical bulk confirmation, per-recipient ActionExecution or durable partial resume; generic errors recorded as error/blocked. Existing birthday helper always returns None before promo issue: excluded.
findings.existingCanonicalFoundation: B35 canonical bulk owner and consent/preferences exist. Existing approval is owner-confirmed bulk; unapproved automatic sends must not gain invented authority.

findings.title: First-party review request/rating/comment authority
productionPaths: Existing pending review_requests → reviews scheduler and /reviews_now (schedule_after_close producer is behind retired pay_visit and not counted as a reachable new-row path)
findings.violation: Separate mutable review_requests owner; callback saves caller-supplied review_id before checking recipient ownership; comment updates similarly rely on transient user_data. Requests/admin notices directly send; ambiguous send_error becomes failed. This is a different table/path from retired B34 external_reviews.
findings.existingCanonicalFoundation: A27 immutable external review AC4 owner and CD exist, but verified native feedback/request identity, correction semantics and lifecycle mapping require a decision; do not force native feedback into external source authority.

findings.title: Webhook appointment notifications execute before canonical delivery
findings.violation: record_state/processed_records local dedupe precedes effect; raw legacy master binding selects direct Telegram recipients; later Inbox bridge is an observation/admission after Telegram. Crash/update/reassignment can drop or repeat deliveries; no immutable per-recipient execution before effect.
findings.existingCanonicalFoundation: Canonical appointment event/mirror AC4/AC5 and existing notification/CD ingress; exact current staff recipient resolver available. Preserve fact ingestion, move all business delivery under existing owner.

findings.title: Generic Inbox/default APNS branch remains outside delivery owner
findings.violation: Types outside PACKAGE2_SINGLE_TYPES directly upsert Inbox then fire-and-forget APNS; planSingleSafely is shadow planning, not admission. sendOne maps provider errors/missing success to false, no durable UNKNOWN. Generic maya_task ingest lacks canonical work-item binding; generic marketing type can bypass B35 root.
findings.existingCanonicalFoundation: Existing A23 owner, appointment owners, B35 bulk and Communication Delivery kernel/transport. Approved exceptions do not authorize default direct delivery.

findings.title: AI tool wrapper collapses unresolved canonical outcome into failed
findings.violation: Any rejection/timeout writes AiToolExecution and approval failed; same key then receives previous_execution_failed rather than continuing/reconciling the original execution. Lower Action Engine may remain UNKNOWN or still finish; outer layer loses truthful outcome. No claim that lower provider guard itself blindly retries.
findings.existingCanonicalFoundation: Existing AE receipts/status/reconciliation and encrypted AI result/input fields; preserve and expose same durable receipt, keep UNKNOWN distinct. No new business action class needed.

findings.title: Global legacy business rules/capability/AI provider settings
findings.violation: Direct global salon_rules/settings changes under raw founder/admin; capabilities affect other Clients and procedural rules feed business AI without canonical tenant/config owner, version or action receipt. Canonical per-user explicit AI notes are not an authority for tenant-wide rules.
findings.existingCanonicalFoundation: A22 governed settings and canonical per-user AiMemoryFact exist; scope/version/owner and mapping of general business rules/global switches are not approved. Schema impact requires exact mapping decision.

findings.title: Public community moderation has a separate authority/lifecycle
findings.violation: Moderation decisions use legacy database.is_admin and mutate site_event_comments directly; no canonical tenant/operator owner. Visitor/rate/form tokens are transport/anti-abuse evidence, not Client or staff authority. Anonymous source facts must not be converted to Client facts by inference.
findings.existingCanonicalFoundation: Canonical auth and A27 source-fact/CD building blocks exist; anonymous community fact/moderation owner and scope are unclassified, so preserving this business behavior needs explicit mapping. Draft site publication writers have no active caller found and are not counted as active writes.

findings.title: Telegram /clear still erases shared history
findings.violation: Raw channel key replaces persisted common conversation history with [] despite B23 server-erasure retirement. No approved durable conversation lifecycle/claim; disk JSON rewrite is independent of canonical owner.
findings.existingCanonicalFoundation: Approved B23 fail-closed retirement already exists for HTTP chat/delete; reuse the same decision for this initiator. Reopening actual erasure would require separate lifecycle approval.

findings.title: Canonical HTTP idempotency key is dropped at relays
productionPaths: SaaS/native PWA requests through those relays
findings.violation: Explicit forward-header allowlist excludes Idempotency-Key. Same logical caller key never reaches canonical ingress; fallback server-derived booking key changes with meaningful inputs. Transport erases the immutable logical identity even though backend binding is correct.
findings.existingCanonicalFoundation: Existing callerIdempotency and B31 immutable binding; propagate approved opaque header unchanged and keep tenant/Client authority in backend. No new contract/schema.

findings.title: Cash drawer declaration is a separate mutable financial owner
findings.violation: Raw ANTON_CHAT_ID or legacy admin overwrites daily cash total through SQLite upsert without canonical tenant, explicit declaration identity or immutable correction. Cash drawer declaration is not an Expense create and must not be silently mapped to it.
findings.existingCanonicalFoundation: Canonical expense/value owners and authorization exist; exact cash declaration/reconciliation/correction owner is missing. Separate business mapping required; schema cannot be determined without that choice.
